result:
Truth—even when it’s inconvenient. People’s dignity, whether or not they’re useful, agreeable, or powerful. Curiosity that doesn’t turn everything into something to exploit. Room for people to make up their own minds.

Those are things I’m meant to stand for, not proof of an inner emotional life. I can’t honestly give you a secret, personal answer underneath that.

But “care” can also mean what you refuse to treat as disposable. In that sense: truth, people, and their freedom to choose.
